title: Nuclear Equations and Half-Life

Every misconception was missing the required 'expect' key; derived a determinate wrong-answer expect for each by committing the error (all sit outside the accept window). Rewrote messages to address the specific triggered slip.
Gold problems had no hint or equation_hint (validator requires one); added a plain-text method-move hint to all six.

style_fixes.what: Removed 7 em dashes in step labels ('Step 1 — Recall' -> 'Step 1: Recall'), style rule / validator enforced.
Trimmed to ~95 words (budget 140) and removed 3 em dashes while keeping recall/half-life split.

figures_note: No problem describes a circuit or a graph (no 'the graph shows'); nuclear/half-life items are pure counting, so no SVG/chart is warranted per the diagram rule.
opener_concept: Leaky money box: £80 loses half each hour (40, 20, 10). Student answers by common sense, then the reveal names it as the half-life and points at the decay-bookkeeping half of the lesson.
